I need to work backwards from this question:

1. A novel whose second sequel was published by Viking Adult
2. The main character of that novel
3. What college did they go to

The most likely candidate is the "Fifty Shades" trilogy by E.L. James. The second sequel would be "Fifty Shades Freed" (published by Viking Adult in 2012). The main character is Anastasia Steele.
